decisions.reason: Adding dimensions for red-marked walls does not change the separate furnished drawing's format or required furnishings.
The dimension request is owned by the separate annotation Requirement and does not alter the floor-plan concept's required content or acceptable format.
The source requests drawing annotations and does not change any corridor dimensions, wall shifts, partition alignment, or space-allocation decision.
Annotating the dimensions of red-marked walls does not change whether any existing or marked wall is preserved, demolished, or constructed.
The source does not identify or change the Unit 1 en-suite configuration, fixture locations, door locations, or unresolved fit conflict.
The wall-dimension annotation request does not change the Unit 1 common bathroom's extent, fixtures, plumbing alignment, or layout.
The source does not change the Unit 3 bathroom, its left-wall fixture placement, or its drain-connection requirements.
Measuring red-marked walls does not alter the Unit 3 counter strategy, bathroom-door clearance constraint, or proposed fixture locations.
The source does not identify or modify the Unit 2 bathroom placement, toilet constraint, or bathroom-door position.
The request for wall-dimension annotations does not change retention or shared use of the existing main entrance.
The source does not discuss or alter balcony retention or its conditional enclosure.
The source does not discuss or alter preservation of the exterior windows.
